role: 镜2尾帧＝男伸手碰女肩想哄、女缩肩扭头不应（较劲）
reuse_note: 镜2首帧复用 shot-01-image-first（吵架起点同机位），本文件只出尾帧。
prompt: Cinematic still, 9:16 vertical, medium wide shot, static, camera facing the sofa straight-on, same living room and same framing as the quarrel-start shot. A bright, airy neutral-warm living room, ceiling light on, soft diffuse daylight, no dim moody lamp. On the two-seat sofa, the realistic East Asian Chinese man about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference man), short neat dark hair, light-grey crew-neck top, leans in from the RIGHT end with his upper body turned toward her, his arm extended, hand reaching toward her shoulder to coax and make up, an apologetic soft look. The realistic East Asian Chinese woman about 30 to 35 years old (identity from the reference woman), shoulder-length loose dark brown hair, oatmeal-beige knit top, at the LEFT end shrugs that shoulder away and twists her head to the far side, refusing to respond, still holding the cushion. His reaching hand hovers in mid-air just short of her shoulder, a wilful standoff. Matte skin with realistic pores, fine film grain, shot on an iPhone with true-to-life handheld realism, no oily facial glare, no highlight on faces, no plastic AI sheen, no wax. They are Chinese with East Asian faces, not western faces. Bright natural neutral-warm color, shallow depth of field. No text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark, no brand anywhere.
prompt_zh: 电影感静帧，9:16竖屏，中景偏宽，静态，镜头正对沙发，与吵架起点同室同机位。明亮通透中性偏暖客厅，顶灯开、漫射日光，无暗黄压抑灯。双人沙发上，真实东亚中国男性(30-35岁，参考男主)，短发、浅灰圆领上衣，从右侧一头上身转向她、手臂伸出、手朝她肩膀探去想哄和好、神情带点服软的柔和。真实东亚中国女性(30-35岁，参考女主)，中长深棕披肩发、燕麦米色针织上衣，在左侧一头把那侧肩膀一缩避开、头扭向另一边不理，仍抱着靠垫。男主伸出的手停在半空、差一点没碰到她肩膀，较劲僵持。哑光肤质有毛孔、自然颗粒，iPhone真实手持质感，无脸部油光/高光/塑料AI感/蜡感。中国东亚脸，非欧美脸。明亮中性偏暖自然色，浅景深。无文字/字幕/logo/水印/品牌。
